service.method: SELECT #DB_OWNER#NVL(PW_RESET_FLAG,'Y') AS PW_RESET_FLAG, #DB_OWNER#NVL(PASS_CHECK_CNT,'0') AS PASS_CHECK_CNT FROM SUSMT WHERE #DB_OWNER#NVL(DEL_FLAG,'N') = 'N' AND USER_ID = upper(${user_id}) AND HOUSE_CODE = ${house_code}

SELECT COMPANY_CODE , PASSWORD, USER_TYPE FROM SUSMT WHERE #DB_OWNER#NVL(DEL_FLAG,'N') = 'N' AND #DB_OWNER#NVL(SIGN_STATUS,'R') = 'A' AND upper(USER_ID) = upper(${user_id}) AND HOUSE_CODE = ${house_code}
UPDATE SUSMT SET PASS_CHECK_CNT = #DB_OWNER#NVL(${pass_check_cnt},PASS_CHECK_CNT+1) WHERE HOUSE_CODE = ${house_code} AND USER_ID = upper(${user_id})

SELECT BALN.CTRL_CODE FROM SUSMT USMT LEFT OUTER JOIN SBALN BALN ON BALN.COMPANY_CODE = USMT.COMPANY_CODE AND BALN.CTRL_PERSON_ID = USMT.USER_ID AND BALN.HOUSE_CODE = USMT.HOUSE_CODE AND #DB_OWNER#NVL( BALN.DEL_FLAG, 'N' ) = 'N' WHERE #DB_OWNER#NVL( USMT.DEL_FLAG, 'N' ) = 'N' AND UPPER( USMT.USER_ID ) = UPPER( ${user_id} )
SELECT TEMP_PW_TIMESTAMP FROM SUSMT WHERE #DB_OWNER#NVL(DEL_FLAG,'N') = 'N' AND #DB_OWNER#NVL(SIGN_STATUS,'R') = 'A' AND upper(USER_ID) = upper(${user_id}) AND HOUSE_CODE = ${house_code}
